data.case_title: Income Tax Prepayment Assessment from 2026 (Finanzamt Musterhafen)
data.explanation: Finanzamt Musterhafen (the local tax office) has decided how much income tax you must prepay each quarter starting in 2026, based on your expected tax liability. You don't need to do anything unless you disagree with the amount: if you think it's wrong, you can file a written or electronic objection (Einspruch) within one month after the notice is considered delivered — the exact date will be shown by the app. Otherwise, make sure the quarterly amount reaches the tax office's account by each of the stated due dates, since late prepayments are usually charged interest. Keep this notice for your records, as it affects your tax return.

items.title: File objection (Einspruch) against the prepayment assessment
items.quote:
Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe
bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.action: File a written or electronic objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterhafen if you disagree with the assessed prepayment amount, by the deadline shown.

items.title: Quarterly income tax prepayment
items.quote:
Die Vorauszahlungen zur Einkommensteuer werden ab dem Kalenderjahr 2026 auf vierteljährlich
420,00 € festgesetzt (fällig jeweils am 10.03., 10.06., 10.09. und 10.12.).
items.action: Pay the quarterly income tax prepayment of 420,00 € to Finanzamt Musterhafen by each of the four due dates each year.

remedy.quote:
Gegen diesen Bescheid ist der Einspruch zulässig. Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe
bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.

data.summary: Finanzamt Musterhafen has set quarterly income tax prepayments (Einkommensteuer-Vorauszahlungen) of 420,00 € starting in 2026, due each year on 10 March, 10 June, 10 September and 10 December. An objection (Einspruch) can be filed within one month after the notice is considered delivered.
